description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Cost 2 Tally

It only takes two hands and one decision.

Your next Strike this turn treats a failure as a success and a success as a critical hit. It cannot upgrade a critical failure. Spending Tally this way is not a Redline and never causes a Slip, but the Tally is gone all the same.

cinderfall.incomplete: Next Strike: failure becomes success, success becomes critical hit; at Cost 2 Tally, once/round, requires a two-handed melee weapon. Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus, and separately, failure-to-success is specifically the one direction AdjustDegreeOfSuccess cannot do (it only ever reclassifies a roll for the better starting from success or better, per the real precedent found in this pass).
